boundary: Local and synthetic staff training catalog only. This is not evidence, agency adoption, consumer acceptance, compliance, public launch, hosted service, SLA, production readiness, vendor compatibility, hardware certification, or ETA-quality proof.

scenarios.label: Baseline local agency walkthrough
scenarios.exercise: Use Start Here to explain schedule import, feed URLs, realtime status, and help boundaries from a clean local demo.
scenarios.does_not_prove: Does not prove agency adoption, public launch, final-root readiness, or consumer display.

scenarios.label: After-midnight service drill
scenarios.exercise: Review agency-local service day, stale thresholds, and conservative matching for late-night trips.
scenarios.does_not_prove: Does not prove real-world overnight reliability or ETA accuracy.

scenarios.label: Frequency-based service drill
scenarios.exercise: Use frequency fixtures to discuss headways, repeated trip instances, and withheld Trip Updates when confidence is insufficient.
scenarios.does_not_prove: Does not prove production-grade ETA quality or real-world headway prediction accuracy.

scenarios.label: Stale and unknown-device recovery drill
scenarios.exercise: Practice tracing stale telemetry and unknown devices through Devices, Telemetry, and Realtime Center.
scenarios.does_not_prove: Does not prove device fleet reliability, vendor compatibility, or hardware certification.

scenarios.label: Disruption and alert lifecycle drill
scenarios.exercise: Review how canceled-trip hints, alert lifecycle, and public Alerts usefulness guidance fit together.
scenarios.does_not_prove: Does not prove public alert display, consumer ingestion, or agency approval.

scenarios.label: Connector conformance tabletop
scenarios.exercise: Map a proposed CSV/API/POST/prediction/monitoring integration to synthetic adapter boundaries before any real credentials exist.
scenarios.does_not_prove: Does not prove named vendor compatibility, real device proof, or hardware certification.
